about.title: How Squeezo works
about.lead: Less weight, same dimensions, and nothing leaves your device.

how.title: From folder to zip

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Choose what goes in and what does not.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: One by one or everything in a zip.

how.drag: Drag the files into the box
how.hint: It is a demo: drag the files, check what you want and compress.

items.name: JPG, WebP and AVIF
items.text: Keeps the lowest quality you cannot notice.

items.name: PNG
items.text: Reduced to a color palette without it showing.

steps.title: Read
steps.text: The image opens in your browser. Its real content, dimensions and format are validated before it is touched.

steps.title: Measure
steps.text: It is compressed at several quality levels and each result is compared with the original, in luminance and in color.

steps.title: Choose
steps.text: Squeezo keeps the lightest version that passes the threshold of the chosen level. If none improves the weight, the original is kept.

steps.title: Verify
steps.text: The final result is measured on the full image, not just on a sample, and only then is it delivered.

band.title: A thousand images in a single tab.
band.text: Squeezo splits the work across the cores of your processor and reads zips in parts, without loading them fully into memory. A large zip is explored instantly and only what you process gets unpacked.

facts.label: to read a zip of 1000 images

items.title: Real content
items.text: Every file is identified by its binary signature, not by its extension. A .jpg that is actually text is rejected.

items.title: Zips without surprises
items.text: Paths with .., encrypted entries and files that inflate beyond what they declare are dropped before they take memory.

items.title: Clean SVGs
items.text: Scripts, events and external references are removed. SVG files are only shown as images, never as documents.

items.title: No traces
items.text: Hidden data in JPG and PNG files, such as the camera and the location, is removed unless you ask to keep it.

items.a: By default only a version that cannot be told apart at a glance is accepted. "High quality" demands differences you cannot see even when zoomed in.
No. Width and height stay the same, unless you turn on limiting the dimensions in the settings.

items.q: What happens to videos inside a zip?
items.a: They are skipped and you are told how many there were. Squeezo only compresses images.
Up to 1000 images per zip and 50 megapixels per image.

items.q: What if I reload the page?
items.a: Your progress is saved in the browser and you pick up where you left off, even in the middle of a compression.

p: Images, folders and zips are processed in your browser and never uploaded to any server. So you do not lose your progress, they are kept in your browser's storage until you press "Clear".
No accounts, no tracking cookies, no analytics and no ads.
The language, the theme and the compression settings are saved in your browser.
When a JPG or a PNG is compressed, hidden data such as the camera or the location is removed, unless you choose to keep it. An image that cannot be reduced is returned as it was.
The site is hosted on Vercel, which may log technical data about the visit, such as the IP. It never includes your images.
The real content of each file is validated, nothing you add is executed, and SVG files are stripped of scripts.
Squeezo is free. Use it only with images you have the right to use.
They remain yours. Squeezo never modifies your originals: it creates copies that you download separately.
The goal is for the difference not to show, but no lossy compression guarantees an identical result. Always keep your originals.
Up to 1000 images per zip. Files that are not images or look dangerous are skipped.
